Generic inject/truncate/kill hooks so the other stateful scenarios plug in

Pluggable agent: fake now (0 spend), real claude -p later
drivers: stateless probe-contract cannot express live-loop scenarios
real multi-turn claude -p runs cost money + are non-deterministic -> defer
the other 7 scenarios reuse the same hook points
